To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the double box with one massless leg off shell can be expressed in terms of a single integral, with a simple integrant consisting of logarithms, dilogarithms and trigamma functions, and that this integral is related to the one-dimensional integral representation for the double box with two massless legs off shell.

(1) The dimensionally regularised double box diagram is analytically computed for the case of one leg off shell, i.e., with q 2 not equal to zero, and three other legs on shell; (2) The answer is expressed in terms of polylogarithms of order four and a one-dimensional logarithmic integral.
(i) the double box diagram with one leg off-shell is finite, and (ii) the double box is a linear combination of (generalized) dilogarithm functions.

the double-box integrals can be expressed in terms of generalized polylogarithms and one-dimensional integrals.
